REPRODUCIBILITY & LIMITS

Keep the evidence with the model.

What is verified

  • Original 31-file checkpoint and frozen manifest hashes preserved.
  • Native BF16 recovery smoke reproduced uninterrupted adapter weights.
  • Separate latest resumable, best-validation and versioned selected artifacts.
  • Checksum/ZIP integrity, 85 software tests, actual 64/64 API parity and headed desktop/mobile checks.

What remains unknown

  • Writer identity and original-model pretraining overlap.
  • Complete human semantic verification of source labels.
  • Other datasets, camera-image robustness and whole-page accuracy.
  • Between-seed robustness; this study used one seed and one capped epoch.

Selected output still has 714 non-exact final crops. Diagnostic flags are heuristics, not calibrated confidence. Constant-pixel abstention does not prove general blank-image detection. Backups are verified locally on D:; no offsite copy or public deployment is claimed.
